definitions.explanation: The act of producing a musical or signaling sound by blowing air through pursed lips, or the sound itself.

examples.japanese: {口笛|くちぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楽|たの}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口笛|くちぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いていた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口笛|くちぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{聞|き}こえなかった→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧ようだ。
examples.english: I whistled to call the dog, but it didn't seem to hear me.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) and ⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧ (flute/whistle). Refers to the sound made by blowing air through pursed lips, whether for music, signaling, or casual amusement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口笛|くちぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to whistle
- {口笛|くちぶえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to whistle a tune
- {口笛|くちぶえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at whistling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧: flute or whistle (instrument) — refers to an actual instrument rather than whistling with the lips
- ⟦{警笛|けいてき}→警笛：22646_keiteki⟧: warning whistle or horn — a mechanical device, not produced by mouth

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, whistling at night is traditionally considered bad luck, as it is said to attract snakes or evil spirits (⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口笛|くちぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧).
